description: QIE sample sizes under both culpability definitions
population: CRSS two-vehicle crashes 2016-2024 (no non-motorist, no hit-and-run vehicle, both drivers present) with exactly one culpable and one non-culpable driver
method: Quasi-induced exposure: RIR = odds of culpability within group (saturated survey logit, linearised CI); adjusted ratios from a multivariable survey logit
